newsitem.title: UK: IPE natural gas futures mostly soft, volumes good.
newsitem.headline: IPE natural gas futures mostly soft, volumes good.

text.p: IPE natural gas futures were broadly weaker across the board on Wednesday and volumes were markedly better than in previous weeks.
A total of 115 lots traded in the morning session compared to 75 lots on Tuesday, 70 lots on Monday, and 70 lots for the whole of last week.
"This is certainly an improvement - I hope it is the harbinger of better things to come," one broker said.
July softened by 0.075 pence per therm to 10.00 pence, while October and November traded 0.09 pence and 0.025 pence down respectively at 12.30 and 13.35 pence.
The only month to trade firmer was December, which changed hands in 35 lots and stood 0.07 pence firmer at 14.60 pence by lunchtime.
January and February next year were 0.025 pence and 0.09 pence down at 17.65 and 17.60 pence respectively.

"The weakness is a follow-on from the general pattern we have seen in the OTC," one broker in the physical market said. "There is a perception that prices in the summer can come off some more, there is enough gas out there."
